suggestion: Reduce NBA-derived content on the public site until reproduction rights are confirmed
why: NBA Terms s.1 and s.9 restrict reproduction and statistics use; the site currently reproduces an injury snapshot and schedule rows
options: A: keep snapshot with attribution (risk remains); B: show links and counts only; C: obtain written permission first
recommended_option: B now; C if the project proceeds

suggestion: Publish no picks or betting recommendations until a Dutch counsel opinion is received
why: Art. 1(b) Wet op de kansspelen restricts promoting unlicensed gambling; Ksa says advertising needs a licence
options: A: publish nothing (current state); B: publish analysis without bet recommendations; C: private research only

suggestion: Provide an allowed network path or a dated owner export for historical NBA data
why: No historical data can be retrieved from this environment; no strategy can be evaluated without it
options: A: allow egress to stats.nba.com and cdn.nba.com; B: owner export of CSVs with provenance notes; C: licensed data vendor
recommended_option: B short term; C before any publication

suggestion: Use a licensed provider with timestamped odds history and written terms
why: No official odds source identified; line comparison and ROI need timestamped prices
options: A: licensed vendor feed; B: owner-captured prices under the operator's terms; C: no prices (research only)
recommended_option: C until counsel reviews A or B

suggestion: Approve gate thresholds and freeze them before any data is loaded
why: Pre-registration limits selection bias and luck-driven leaderboard results
options: A: strict proposed defaults (gates.csv); B: looser defaults; C: no thresholds (not recommended)

suggestion: Refresh the injury snapshot from the newest official report on a fixed cadence and store each revision
why: Reports are updated continually; a stale snapshot can mislead a slate
options: A: manual refresh before each slate; B: scheduled job (needs egress); C: no refresh
recommended_option: B once egress exists; A until then

suggestion: Define the 3-day horizon as calendar dates inclusive (Nov 13-16 for today's run)
why: Brief says up to 3 days; prior dashboard used 72 hours
options: A: calendar dates inclusive; B: 72 hours from run time; C: 3 game-days

suggestion: Show an as-of timestamp and a stale-data warning on every table
why: Reviewers need to see whether a value is current
options: A: timestamp per page; B: timestamp per row; C: none

suggestion: Commit a hash of each strategy spec before its data is loaded
why: Shows the strategy was not changed after seeing results
options: A: hash in strategies.csv; B: signed commit; C: none

suggestion: Run an external-link check on a schedule and not only on deploy
why: Prior workflow did not fetch external links; links can rot
options: A: weekly scheduled job; B: on every PR; C: manual
A: MIT; B: all rights reserved (no licence file); C: other

suggestion: Delete stale remote session branches after owner review
why: Four remote arena/* branches exist; three have no PR
options: A: delete after review; B: keep; C: archive

suggestion: Add a decision log page where the owner records the chosen option and date
why: Keeps choices auditable and separate from implementation
options: A: decision log in suggestions.csv; B: issue tracker; C: none

suggestion: Add an injury parser with test fixtures before transcribing later reports
why: Manual transcription from extracted PDF text is error-prone
options: A: parser with fixtures; B: manual transcription with a second check; C: no injury table
